en.horario: Can be visited during the day and at night.

en.actividades: Visit Mount Yasur volcano, explore the local culture, hike through the rainforest, relax on the beaches.
en.consejos: Watch Mount Yasur erupt at night, visit the traditional villages, try kava.
en.comentarios: Island with an active volcano, traditional culture and stunning landscapes.

visa.descripcion: For tourist stays of up to 30 days for most nationalities. It is recommended to check the specific requirements for your nationality.

en.clima: Tropical, with a dry season and a rainy season. Best time to visit: during the dry season (April to October).
en.gastronomia: Lap lap (taro root pudding), tuluk (meat sausage), grilled fish, tropical fruit, kava (traditional drink).
en.cultura: Melanesian and Polynesian influences, with a rich tradition of music, dance and crafts. Festivals: Independence Day, Vanuatu Arts Festival, Christmas.
en.seguridad: Taking precautions in urban areas and checking travel advisories is recommended.
